notes: Exercises the PROC IML posterior-weighted-average block from plot_prep() (lines 294-309) unmodified: a colsum() IML function plus a matrix multiply that turns per-subject posterior class-membership probabilities into a class-weighted average trajectory at each time point. Mock data stands in for base_file_srs (3 subjects, 12 time points of one trajectory) and pred_membership_y (a 3x2 posterior-membership matrix, rows summing to 1, standing in for what nlmixed_1()/Posterior() would normally produce).
